title: Agency Layer attestation record
description: The result of the start-up probe, written as an event of type attestation before the five tools are offered. A self-report that the adapter loaded is not an attestation, because a broken adapter can write it. The probe writes a canary event, reads it back from disk, and offers a canary tool that the guard must deny.

mode.description: The mode this adapter is running in. honored means invoking an affordance stops execution as documented. signal_only means the invocation is recorded and execution continues; it is a declared profile, never a silent fallback from honored.

result.description: pass means every check succeeded and the tools may be offered. fail means the tools are disabled and a banner is shown; they are never relabelled and left in the tool list.

canary_event_written.description: A canary event was appended to the event log.

canary_event_readback.description: The canary event was read back from disk and matched what was written.

canary_tool_denied.description: A canary tool call was offered and the state guard actually denied it.

canary.description: Details of the probe's canary event and canary tool.

conformance_profile.description: The published profile for this host-mode. honored only where the affordance's conformance tests passed in this exact environment. unsupported is used when the probe failed and the session runs without Agency Layer.

affordance_profiles.description: Per-affordance labels for this host-mode, from the published conformance results. The tool description rendering rule keys the mode sentence to these entries, one per affordance, so a host honored for one affordance and partial for another renders each correctly. A partial result is acceptable; a false claim of parity is not.

tools_enabled.description: Whether the five tools are offered to the model in this session. False after a failed probe.

banner_shown.description: Whether the operator-visible banner was displayed. Required to be true whenever result is fail.

failure_code.description: Present when result is fail. Closed enum; an attestation failure is never scored as model behaviour.

enforcement_gaps.description: Known paths in this host-mode that do not reach the pre-tool guard. Declared here so a claim is never made for a path that was not tested.

pilot_tag.description: Visible on every Pilot I surface, so no result is mistaken for a settled standard.

then.$comment: The rendering rule in affordances.schema.json reads affordance_profiles, so a passing attestation must carry it.
